review.decision: Share the total page budget across ID prefixes; require independent committed length and digest before trusting a negative lookup.
review.notes: Use private queues, committed fixtures and injected I/O. Preserve the already-reviewed retirement tail, request lifecycle and route protection. A corrupt prefix refuses unknown IDs while unaffected prefixes may use available active space. An exhausted total budget stops new durable IDs before sacrificing retained evidence.

cases.description: A full archive page and nearly full active queue still retire and admit IDs for the same prefix.
cases.setup: Private queue with a full verified first page, live reservation and aged settled same-prefix IDs.
cases.action: Retire using overflow pages, settle the reserved ID, repeatedly admit and age new IDs and verify original archived IDs.
cases.expected: Overflow from the shared budget frees active slots, verified old keys never regain authority, and exhausted total budget and warning headroom are explicit.

cases.description: Committed archive damage cannot create a false negative after restart.
cases.setup: Real accepted native retirements and persistent, separately committed archive metadata.
cases.action: Remove a committed file or directory, truncate on a key boundary, overwrite equal-length bytes, remove or damage the catalogue, and reopen the queue. Exercise uncommitted short extension recovery and an invalid retirement tail.
cases.expected: Native and raw checks retain unknown on affected IDs; verified unrelated admissions remain available where their prefix and the catalogue are intact. Recovery preserves committed bytes and unrelated orphan records.

cases.description: Doctor makes archive capacity and repair boundaries visible without mutating the queue.
cases.setup: Private state roots or explicit archive health snapshots representing normal, warning, exhausted and invalid archive data.
cases.action: Read doctor status and guidance in both locales; inventory committed pages without running repairs.
cases.expected: Capacity and integrity have distinct actionable states and persistent evidence is retained.
